results.name: Native CopperBench schema 5 with explicit mm; no new mechanical wrapper
Source document, dates and editable geometry are not mutated
Filename is JSON, useful, bounded and safe for paths
Every supported outline remains native rather than flattened
Custom outline summary uses actual extents without shifting its origin
Bottom parts keep local pads: mirror X then rotate exactly once
Active linked mounting holes are retained locally and never duplicated at root
Disabled module mounting pattern is reference-only, not a set of new bores
Module envelope height is not increased by stack gap a second time
Carrier and platform references and attached keepouts survive export
Every library variant exports its embedded footprint without catalog substitution
Board slots, plated pad slots and vias retain their dimensions and identities
Cutouts are kept as independent native polygons
Copper design errors and unrouted nets do not block a mechanical handoff
Unfilled planes are preserved and do not block enclosure export
Board-only handoff omits artwork, images, baseline and unused library
Project extras option retains the complete project data
Export reopens in CopperBench as native schema 5
Future native schema is rejected, not relabelled as 5
Wrong units and non-project JSON fail with actionable errors
Blank board works and reports that component envelopes are absent
Self-intersecting board and cutout boundaries fail safely
Out-of-board parts warn but are not moved or silently dropped
CaseBench native adapter component limit is preflighted
CaseBench polygon limit is preflighted without simplification
Oversized contours are refused before expensive boundary validation
CaseBench cutout count limit is preflighted
CaseBench JSON limit counts UTF-8 bytes and does not truncate the file
Snapshot is deterministic for an unchanged design, with stable IDs
Both board-face stored envelope maxima are summarized without changing bodies
All shipped native starter projects keep their placed geometry and block members
